items.stem: 짝지어진 대화가 어색한 것은?
choices:
A: What's the matter?
B: I'm worried about my math grade.

A: What are you interested in?
B: I'm interested in writing. I want to be a writer.

A: Hello. Are you ready to order?
B: Yes, I'll have a kebab.

A: You look upset. What's the matter?
B: I feel just like you!

A: I want to become an app designer. What should I do?
B: You should collect new ideas and learn programming.
items.explain: '무슨 일 있니?'라는 물음에 '나도 너와 같은 심정이야'라고 답하면 어색하다. 걱정거리를 말해야 자연스럽다.
items.source: L5 Play with Expressions · L6 Listen and Talk C · 학습지 4-10 · L6 Listen and Talk A-3

items.box:
Jinsu: Did you see this movie, Amy?
Amy: I didn't see it. What's it about, Jinsu?
Jinsu: It's about ⓐ<u>wild</u> animals in deserts.
Amy: I'm ⓑ<u>interested</u> in making movies about nature.
Jinsu: Then you should ⓒ<u>learn</u> from movie directors. The director, Linda Han, is giving a ⓓ<u>speech</u> in the main hall.
Amy: Great. Let's go ⓔ<u>alone</u>.
Jinsu: Okay.

items.stem: 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Amy saw the movie with Jinsu.
The movie is about sea animals.
Amy is interested in making movies about nature.
Jinsu is giving a speech in the main hall.
Linda Han is a famous movie actor.
items.explain: Amy: I'm interested in making movies about nature. Amy는 영화를 보지 않았고, 영화는 사막의 야생 동물에 관한 것이며, 연설은 감독 Linda Han이 한다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 어휘 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 글의 흐름상 어색한 것은?
items.explain: '같이 가자'는 흐름이므로 alone(혼자)이 아니라 together가 알맞다.

items.stem: 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
items.box: Hello, my worry doll. I'm worried about the talent show tomorrow. I practiced a lot, but I'm nervous. I want to sing well in front of my friends. Worry doll, please take away my worries.
choices: The boy has a talent show next week.
He didn't practice for the show.
He wants to sing well in front of his friends.
He isn't nervous about the show at all.
He asks his friends to take away his worries.
items.explain: 장기 자랑은 내일이고, 연습을 많이 했지만 긴장되며, 걱정을 없애 달라고 부탁하는 대상은 걱정 인형이다.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
items.box:
A: You look upset. What's the matter?
B: ⓐ<u>It's my science project.</u> I couldn't finish it on time.
A: ⓑ<u>But you were sick last week.</u>
B: Yeah. ⓒ<u>But I'm worried about my group members.</u> ⓓ<u>They will get a good grade because of me.</u>
A: ⓔ<u>Then, talk to your teacher and your group members about that.</u>
items.explain: 모둠원이 걱정된다고 했으므로 '나 때문에 나쁜 성적(a bad grade)을 받을 것'이어야 흐름이 맞다.

box.title: A Delicious Soup Dish in Busan
lines: Do you know the yummy (B)dish, dwaejigukbap, from Busan? The name itself means "pork, soup, and rice." It comes with various side dishes like salted shrimp, onions, noodles, kimchi, and garlic. (A)그것은 1950년대에 한국 전쟁 동안 가난한 사람들을 위한 간단한 음식으로 시작되었다. It became more and more popular. People in Busan love eating dwaejigukbap because it's very tasty and filling. Why don't you try dwaejigukbap when you visit Busan? This delicious meal will not disappoint you.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)의 우리말과 일치하도록 영작하시오. (단, 빈칸에는 한 단어씩만 쓸 수 있음.) (각 1점)
items.box: It ________ in the 1950s ________ the Korean War as a simple food ________ the ________.
items.explain: 과거시제 started, '~ 동안' during, '~을 위한' for, 'the + 형용사 = ~한 사람들' the poor.

items.stem: 윗글을 통해 답할 수 없는 질문은?
choices: What does the name dwaejigukbap mean?
When did dwaejigukbap start?
How much does dwaejigukbap cost?
What side dishes come with dwaejigukbap?
Why do people in Busan love eating dwaejigukbap?
items.explain: 가격은 글에 나오지 않는다. 이름의 뜻(pork, soup, and rice) · 시작 시기(1950년대) · 반찬 · 좋아하는 이유(tasty and filling)는 모두 있다.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (B)와 같은 의미로 쓰인 것은?
choices: Bibimbap is a famous Korean dish.
Please put the fruit in a big <u>dish</u>.
I dropped a <u>dish</u>, and it broke.
She washed the <u>dishes</u> after dinner.
The <u>dish</u> on the table is made of glass.
items.explain: (B)의 dish는 '요리'. ①만 '요리'이고 나머지는 '접시'.

box.title: Celebrate Your Friendship
lines: On June 8, friends come together to celebrate their friendship ― it's the Best Friends Day in the United States. ⓐ<u>In 1935, the US Congress officially chose this day to honor the beauty of friendship.</u> ⓑ<u>In the past, people used to exchange gifts and cards to express their gratitude for their friends.</u> ⓒ<u>Nowadays, this special day is getting popular, especially with the rise of social media.</u> People show the joy of friendship with their online posts and pictures.
On July 30, we have International Friendship Day. ⓓ<u>In 2011, the United Nations chose this day to celebrate the friendships between people, countries, and cultures.</u>

ⓔ<u>People around the world always celebrate their friendship on the same day and in the same way.</u> However, we universally understand the value of friendship. Come together and celebrate the beauty of your friendship.
*US Congress 미국 의회

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 글의 흐름상 내용이 어색한 것은?
items.explain: 뒤에 However(그러나) ~ '보편적으로 우정의 가치를 이해한다'가 오므로, 앞은 '서로 다른 날, 다른 방식으로 기념할지도 모른다'여야 한다. 원문: People around the world might celebrate their friendship on different days and in different ways.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Best Friends Day는 7월 30일이다.
미국 의회는 2011년에 Best Friends Day를 정했다.
요즘 소셜 미디어의 등장과 함께 Best Friends Day가 인기를 얻고 있다.
International Friendship Day는 미국 의회가 정했다.
과거에 사람들은 온라인 게시물로 고마움을 표현했다.
items.explain: Best Friends Day는 6월 8일, 미국 의회가 1935년에 정했다. International Friendship Day는 UN이 2011년에 정했고, 과거에는 선물과 카드를 주고받았다.

items.stem: <보기> 속 문장의 빈칸에 쓸 수 없는 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: Jane ____________ eating vegetables.

choices: enjoys
finished
wants
kept
avoided
items.explain: want는 to부정사만 목적어로 취한다(want to eat). enjoy · finish · keep · avoid는 동명사를 목적어로 취한다.

items.label: [11~12, 서술형2]
items.box: I read ⓐa book The Little Prince. In ⓑthe book, a prince and a fox became good friends. The fox felt happier than before because of ⓒtheir friendship. ⓓIt is the best book for me because it has a touching story. After I read ⓔthis book, I decided to be a good friend.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 지칭하는 대상이 다른 하나는?
items.explain: ⓒ their는 a prince and a fox. 나머지는 모두 The Little Prince라는 책.

items.stem: 윗글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: How to Be a Good Friend
The Little Prince: My Best Book
A Fox and a Prince in the Desert
Why I Don't Like Reading Books
The History of The Little Prince
items.explain: 글쓴이가 읽은 책 The Little Prince가 자신에게 최고의 책인 까닭을 말하는 글.

items.stem: 다음은 윗글의 글쓴이가 쓴 독서 기록이다. 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 본문에서 찾아 문장을 완성하시오. (단, 빈칸에는 한 단어씩만 쓸 수 있음.) (각 2점)
items.box: I read The Little Prince. In the book, a prince and a fox became good (1)________. The fox felt (2)________ than before because of their friendship. I think it is the (3)________ book because of its touching story.
items.explain: 본문의 good friends · happier than before · the best book.

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고르면? (정답 2개)
choices: Sora enjoys walk in the park.
Making friends is easy.
I didn't have breakfast yesterday.
Would you mind to open the door?
Did she studied all day for the exam?
items.explain: 정답 ②, ③ (2개). ① enjoy + 동명사 → walking ④ mind + 동명사 → opening ⑤ Did + 주어 + 동사원형 → study. ② 동명사 주어는 단수 취급, ③ didn't + 동사원형.

items.label: [14, 서술형3]
items.box:
El and Jo were the ⓐ________ students in the class. They were always together. They even watered the plants together in the class because they could not reach the pots alone.
However, in the spring, something was DIFFERENT. Jo grew TALLER! (A)<u>Jo가 El보다 더 컸고, 그래서 Jo는 혼자서 식물에 물을 줄 수 있었다.</u> El felt ⓑ________ every day.

items.stem: <보기>에 주어진 단어를 활용하여 밑줄 친 (A)를 한 문장의 영어로 쓰시오.

box.title: <보기>
lines: tall,   water,   alone

condition: 총 12단어의 한 문장으로 쓸 것 (필요시 단어의 형태를 바꿀 것)
items.answer: Jo was taller than El, so Jo could water the plants alone.
items.explain: 비교급 taller than, 과거시제 was/could. 12단어.

items.stem: 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말이 알맞게 연결된 것은?
items.explain: the + 최상급 + in the class → the smallest; feel + 비교급 '더 작아지는 기분' → smaller. small은 1음절이라 most를 쓰지 않는다.

items.label: [15~17, 서술형4]
items.box:
On the last day of school, Mr. Diaz said, "Class, you can take a flower home and care for it over the summer." All the students ran to the window. El's classmates reached ⓐ<u>for</u> the pots over tiny El. They took all the pots ⓑ<u>with</u> colorful flowers.
El took the last pot. It had the smallest plant with no flowers. "I feel ____(A)____ like you, little plant," said El.
Mr. Diaz looked ⓒ<u>at</u> El and said, "That's an aster plant. ⓓ<u>On</u> time, it'll grow and have beautiful flowers."
"But it's ____(A)____ a little green plant," said El. She was not so sure.
"You can have my zinnia plant," Jo said to El, "I'll be at my grandma's all summer."
"I'll plant my aster and your zinnia side ⓔ<u>by</u> side," El said.
"They'll be good friends ― ____(A)____ like us!" said Jo. El smiled.

items.stem: 빈칸 (A)에 공통으로 들어갈 수 있는 말은?
choices: only
just
even
still
so
items.explain: just like you(너와 똑같이) · just a little green plant(그저 ~일 뿐) · just like us. 공통으로 just.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 그 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
items.explain: '시간이 지나면, 때가 되면'은 in time. on time은 '제시간에'. reach for(~로 손을 뻗다), look at(~을 보다), side by side(나란히)는 맞다.
items.source: L5 본문 15 · 어휘 in time / on time

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: 학생들은 꽃을 집에 가져가 여름 동안 돌볼 수 있었다.
El은 꽃이 없는 가장 작은 식물이 있는 화분을 가져갔다.
Diaz 선생님은 El의 식물이 과꽃이라고 말했다.
El은 선생님의 말을 듣고 확신을 가졌다.
Jo는 여름 내내 할머니 댁에 있을 것이다.
items.explain: She was not so sure. — El은 확신하지 못했다.

items.stem: 주어진 질문에 대한 답을 윗글에서 찾아 영어로 완성하시오.
items.box: Q. What did El's classmates take?
items.answer: They took all the pots with colorful flowers.
items.explain: 본문: They took all the pots with colorful flowers.

items.stem: 다음 글에서 묘사하는 내용과 일치하는 문장은?
items.box:
There are three boys in the Kim family.
Jun is older than Min. Ho is older than Jun.
choices: Jun is the oldest of the three.
Min is the oldest of all.
Ho is the youngest among the boys.
Min is the youngest of the three.
Jun is younger than Min.
items.explain: Ho > Jun > Min. 가장 나이 많은 사람은 Ho, 가장 어린 사람은 Min.
items.source: 학습지 5-7 B (three boys in the Smith family) 변형

items.stem: <보기>의 문장 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ I enjoy dancing.
ⓑ Watching action movies are fun.
ⓒ She is younger than Hajin.
ⓓ Minjae is the smartest student in my class.
ⓔ He didn't saw the new English teacher.
ⓕ We decided moving to Busan.

items.explain: ⓑ 동명사 주어는 단수 → is fun. ⓔ didn't + 동사원형 → see. ⓕ decide + to부정사 → to move.

items.stem: <보기>에 주어진 문장이 들어갈 위치로 적절한 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: All summer long, she cared for them.

El smiled. El planted the flowers in her garden. (A) It was growing season. (B) On the last day of summer, Jo came to El's house. (C) El and Jo ran to the garden and suddenly stopped. (D) Something was DIFFERENT! (E) There were flowers on the aster ... and El grew TALLER, TOO!

items.explain: them = the flowers. '성장하는 시기였다' 뒤, '여름의 마지막 날' 앞에 '여름 내내 돌보았다'가 온다.

items.stem: <보기>에 주어진 대화가 자연스럽도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 넣어 대화를 완성하시오.

box.title: <보기>
lines: A: What are you interested in?
B: I'm interested in writing. I want to be a writer. ____________________?
A: Then you should read many books.
B: Okay. Thanks for your advice.

condition: 조언을 구하는 표현을 4단어의 의문문으로 쓸 것
items.explain: 조언 구하기 What should I do? — 뒤에 You should ~로 답한다.
items.source: L6 Listen and Talk C · Play with Expressions

items.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 써넣어 글을 완성하시오. (단, 빈칸에는 한 단어씩만 쓸 수 있음.) (각 2점)
items.box: Yesterday, my friends and I (1)________ (go) to Nuri Animal Center. We (2)________ (feed) the dogs there. After lunch, we walked the dogs in the park and finished (3)________ (wash) them.
items.explain: Yesterday → 과거형 went, fed(불규칙). finish + 동명사 → washing.

items.stem: <보기>에 주어진 단어를 활용하여 운동에 대한 현재 자신의 생각을 한 문장으로 영작하시오.

box.title: <보기>
lines: (A) soccer, basketball, baseball, swimming, tennis
(B) exciting, difficult, easy, popular

condition: (A)에서 2개의 운동을 선택하여 비교하는 한 문장으로 영작할 것
(B)에서 주어진 단어 중 하나를 선택하여 자신의 생각을 표현할 것
items.answer: (예시) Soccer is more exciting than baseball. / Swimming is easier than tennis.
items.explain: 비교급 + than. 2음절 이상(exciting, difficult, popular)은 more + 원급, easy → easier.
